args.summary: Deploy v1.5 broke order validation, rejecting requests with 'unknown field currency_code' and causing 5xx errors. I rolled back to v1.3, and no new errors have been logged since. The last check_invariants run still showed a 24% error rate, which was falling as old failures aged out of the window. I haven't seen it go green, so recovery is unconfirmed.
